notes: Playback no longer stops about a second after you press play: the WebView pauses its own media element the moment the audio-focus request is superseded (including by this app’s own native audio-focus helper), so an unrequested pause in the opening seconds of a song is now recognised and the song is put straight back — it never reaches the screen, and what happened is recorded on the device so it can be read back instead of guessed at

Audio focus is no longer re-asked for while a song is playing. Re-requesting mid-song handed the system’s focus loss to the WebView’s own audio stream, and the WebView’s answer to losing focus is to pause the song — that was the “stops a second in” bug. Focus is asked for once when playback starts, and again the next time you press play

A waiting app update can no longer be applied from a pause you did not make — only a pause you asked for applies it. An interruption used to turn into a full page reload mid-song, which made a one-second hiccup permanent

Album song reordering now needs a three-second hold instead of a third of a second, so an accidental press on a song row can no longer open the Reorder Songs sheet. The row fills as you hold it, so the wait is visible rather than feeling dead
A call (or any other app taking over) still pauses the song, and it still comes back by itself when the call ends — that behaviour is unchanged
